data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-y-d', meaning 'to please'. In Islam, the name Muayyadaa represents the ultimate pleasure and gratification one can receive from Allah SWT. The name Muayyadaa carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure, Gratification” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muayyadaa usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure, gratification and live with faith, good character and purpose.
